caption:
At Web Summit, our stand showed a galaxy: six suns, our human team, and every planet around them an AI agent. 117 of them on 20 November.

Everyone asked the same question: how do you manage them? Our answer: Agent Behaviour Policies. Every agent has written limits and escalates before it goes further. That is how Vicky ran a whole newsroom with developers and many agents.

The Galaxy: web-summit.sgit.ai

The presenter is synthetic and the voice is AI-generated.
